localBearer.description: Private inherited-pipe session. No bootstrap route or browser enrollment.

foundation.title: FoundationContracts
foundation.description: Authoritative F01 v1 shapes. Validation is not dependency resolution, integrity verification, approval authentication or readiness. See DESIGN_IR.md.

RelativePath.description: Portable bundle-relative slash path, not a host filesystem path. No drives, traversal, empty segments, percent escapes, ADS or Windows reserved basenames. Host confinement/symlink checks are F04.

Transform.description: Affine local transform [a,b,c,d,tx,ty], x'=ax+cy+tx and y'=bx+dy+ty. Translation is in design units; origin is separate.

Layout.description: Normalizer in F02 owns defaults; schema validation never inserts them. Numeric dimensions are fixed design units. No percentages or CSS/native fields.

blur.description: Representable evidence; outside the initial exact rendering profile.

StyledRange.description: Zero-based half-open UTF-16 code units; no implicit Unicode normalization. F02 checks order, coverage and surrogate boundaries. Grapheme editing is adapter policy.

flow.description: Required semantically for frame; row/column/stack have intrinsic direction and group does not allocate layout.

crop.description: Explicit source-pixel crop, distinct from node transform; semantic bounds checks belong to F02/F05.

persistedBytes.description: Cumulative staged bytes through this manifest; the final capture result additionally accounts for its own bytes.

ifMatch.description: Strong quoted ETag of the base content. Both fields must resolve to the same base; F03/F08 enforce atomically.

HandoffManifest.description: No manifest self-hash; payload artifacts never contain bundleId. Hash canonical payload including sorted artifact hashes, excluding bundleId and volatile delivery metadata only. Integrity is not authorship. F03 trusted store validates approval, F08/later compiler publishes atomically.

ReferenceDiagnostic.description: Closed nonsecret observations only. Absence on legacy evidence means unknown, never a reconstructed diagnosis. A command diagnostic without a receipt is not durable proof.

JobVersion.description: Authoritative stored job row version, not a client counter or artifact schema version.

command.description: Fixed command registry name, never echoed arbitrary argv. F08 validates registry membership.

usage.description: Usage generated from the fixed command registry, not user input.

FoundationVersionedJobResponse.description: F08 successful job response with an authoritative row version. Refines the shared envelope without invalidating legacy unversioned job responses.
